{{M2|Lagavulin Matriarch}} is a {{2|Bosses|Boss}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Lagavulin Matriarch}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Sleep
|Intent = Sleep
|Effect = Asleep. Does nothing.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Slash
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (19;{{Asc2|9|21}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Disembowel
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (9;{{Asc2|9|10}}) damage x2.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Slash2
|Intent = Attack3, Defend
|Effect = Deals (12;{{Asc2|9|14}}) damage. Gains (12;{{Asc2|8|14}}) {{KW2|Block}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Block
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Soul Siphon
|Intent = Debuff, Buff
|Effect = Removes 2 {{BD2|Strength}} and 2 {{BD2|Dexterity}} from the player. Gains 2 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
|GivesToPlayer = Strength (Negative), Dexterity (Negative)
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The {{M2|Lagavulin Matriarch}} starts {{BD2|Asleep}} with 12 {{BD2|Plating}}. It sleeps for 3 turns or until it takes unblocked damage, whichever comes first. When it wakes up, it loses its {{BD2|Plating}}.

After waking, it repeats this four-move cycle:
# {{Int2|Lagavulin Matriarch|Slash}}
# {{Int2|Lagavulin Matriarch|Disembowel}}
# {{Int2|Lagavulin Matriarch|Slash2}}
# {{Int2|Lagavulin Matriarch|Soul Siphon}}

== Useful Cards ==
* '''Lagavulin Matriarch''' gives the player three free turns to set up, making it easy to play expensive powers like {{C2|Demon Form}} or {{C2|Reaper Form}}.
* {{Int2|Lagavulin Matriarch|Soul Siphon}} permanently reduces the player's {{BD2|Strength}} and {{BD2|Dexterity}} by 2 each time it is used. Cards like {{C2|Conflagration}} or {{C2|Death's Door}} will be much weaker because this debuff affects each individual instance of damage or {{KW|Block}}, while cards like {{C2|Bury}} or {{C2|Impervious}} will barely be affected.

== Trivia ==
{{M2|Lagavulin Matriarch}}'s appearance, abilities, and name are a reference to the {{M|Lagavulin||1}} Elite from Slay the Spire 1.
